Status: this table is a SPECIFICATION. The walk in scan_roots is the
production implementation of the rule; parseArtifactLocation is the pure TS
statement of it and currently has no production caller (vendor-copy, a later
slice, is its intended use). The value here is that the rule cannot drift on
one side of the boundary unnoticed.
One asymmetry the table cannot express: the walk additionally requires a
`.claude-plugin/` marker directory before treating `<x>/skills/...` as a plugin,
which is a filesystem fact the pure TS rule cannot see. Every path below is one
where both sides agree; the marker-less case is covered by a Rust-only test.
